scope: Refuse VPORT typed DXF output for render and default-lighting enum values outside Autodesk's published domains.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Vport::validateDxf now requires renderMode <= 6 and defaultLightingType <= 1 in addition to existing payload-width, shade-mode, UCS and color checks. DWG parsing/encoding continues to use validatePayloadFields and is unchanged.
implementation.failureBehavior: ASCII and Binary VPORT writes reject renderMode=7 or defaultLightingType=2 before record emission and preserve an existing destination prefix.

focused.coverage: Both ASCII and Binary: invalid enum values preserve an existing destination; valid upper bounds renderMode=6/defaultLightingType=1 serialize and are read back exactly. Existing VPORT reference mapping, refusal and fresh-writer retry controls in the same selector pass.

limits: No physical VPORT producer or native rendering evidence was used.
The guard establishes published enum-domain output correctness only; it does not qualify visual behavior or whole-document conversion.
No DWG parser/encoder behavior changed and no support claim was promoted.
next: Continue the remaining source-backed rendering and whole-document graph work; keep native VPORT semantics open.
